Independent focused audit of the merged corrective revision found every reported semantic failure resolved at exact final SHA d8438d69fb7dc6c3c42fac272943909e2059f535. The authored corrective SHA is b493118a04cc1004b0b8b1a3f84d4b8fc5ea9c27 with parent 685faec793b2b227e79feb9118f21c69d2347f4a. The server-rebased final parent is 898d3e8f7f7e4f000c0b183dcc4336d17a8fb03b. All 11 ticket file-impact blobs are identical between the authored and final revisions. The final commit changes only criterion_preview.py, executor.py, and gates/code-review.yaml relative to its parent.

The five revised prose blocks now match the four findings. The criterion_preview module assigns bounded response latency only to preview_or_job. The preview_criterion docstring states that timeout classifies late work but does not bound direct-call latency. Its adjacent comment explains executor shutdown. A 0.050 second probe measured preview_criterion at 0.365 seconds and preview_or_job at 0.054 seconds with HTTP 202, followed by a completed poll. The resolve_value docstring includes secret expressions, and ${{ secrets.S }} resolved to resolved-secret. The code-review header reserves determinism for the scripted decision. Parsed workflow evidence shows verify is an agent step at temperature 0, decide uses code_review_decide, and coach is an agent step with provider-default sampling.

Independent checks at the final SHA passed. Normalized Python ASTs, protected directives, and parent-to-final YAML data are equal. Comment hygiene, scoped Ruff, scoped format, and path-scoped diff-check pass. The complete ticket-focused set reports 191 passed. Mypy reports no issues in 771 source files. Concurrent commit 1e7d9dbf4d4e6 added the two code-review-failover entries before this corrective commit, which explains immutable-base YAML data drift without belonging to this prose correction. No repository edit, new commit, push, plan review, completion verification, close, or full test suite was performed by this audit.
